program_name: Bachelor of Arts in European Studies

programme_facts.value: European Studies at the University of Limerick is a broad and integrated world-class programme that allows students an in-depth opportunity to study European languages and policy, equipping them with highly sought-after digital and research skills.

metadata.chunk_title: Why study European Studies at UL?

programme_facts.value: It is the only European Studies programme in Ireland which includes Irish as one of its language options.

metadata.chunk_title: Why study European Studies at UL?

programme_facts.value: Brexit means more direct interaction with the EU and with individual member states on the continent. A better knowledge of the European Union, and Ireland’s place within it, is more needed than ever before.

metadata.chunk_title: Why study European Studies at UL?

programme_facts.value: An understanding of Europe requires knowledge of its historical origins, economic, legal, societal aspects, and political institutions.

metadata.chunk_title: Why study European Studies at UL?

programme_facts.value: The University of Limerick has long led the way in Ireland in this field, resulting in this degree being one of the longest established European Studies degree programmes in Europe.

metadata.chunk_title: Why study European Studies at UL?

value: A healthy curiosity about how modern societies function
An interest in the European Union, and the issues facing the Union and its member states
A taste for languages other than your own
An interest in developing digital and research skills
An interest in working in teams and working independently
An ability to think independently and argue coherently for your ideas

metadata.chunk_title: Programme Information

programme_facts.value: The Faculty of Arts, Humanities and Social Sciences (AHSS) is a dynamic community where ideas are explored, challenged, and brought to life. It offers high‑quality teaching and a rich research environment that spans traditional disciplines and innovative interdisciplinary work.

metadata.chunk_title: Arts, Humanities and Social Sciences + Education and Health Sciences + The Kemmy Business School + Faculty of Science and Engineering + The Irish World Academy of Music and Dance

programme_facts.value: The Education and Health Sciences (EHS) Faculty includes the Schools of Medicine, Allied Health, Education, and Nursing and Midwifery as well as the Departments of Psychology, Physical Education and Sport Sciences. The faculty has built a reputation for high-quality teaching and innovative academic programmes. It works hard to prepare excellent scientists and caring, competent health professionals.

metadata.chunk_title: Arts, Humanities and Social Sciences + Education and Health Sciences + The Kemmy Business School + Faculty of Science and Engineering + The Irish World Academy of Music and Dance

programme_facts.value: The Kemmy Business School (KBS) is a dynamic, innovative business school with a reputation, established over 30 years, for delivering a first-class business education that prepares graduates for successful, rewarding careers across a wide range of business disciplines and professions.

metadata.chunk_title: Arts, Humanities and Social Sciences + Education and Health Sciences + The Kemmy Business School + Faculty of Science and Engineering + The Irish World Academy of Music and Dance

programme_facts.value: The Faculty of Science and Engineering is well recognised for the quality of its teaching and learning, academic programmes and research expertise. It has three world-class research institutes in Materials and Surface Sciences, Software Engineering and Mathematics, all underpinned by well-established industry links.

metadata.chunk_title: Arts, Humanities and Social Sciences + Education and Health Sciences + The Kemmy Business School + Faculty of Science and Engineering + The Irish World Academy of Music and Dance

programme_facts.value: The Irish World Academy of Music and Dance is the centre of academic and performance excellence at University of Limerick, Ireland. It honours the energies of performance and academic reflection across a wide range of genres and disciplines. These are informed by community outreach and artist-in-residence initiatives that take the Academy to the wider community, attracting international performance and scholarly expertise.

programme_facts.value: UL faculty participating in Erasmus+ Staff Mobility for Teaching must ensure that the receiving institution is a university with whom the University of Limerick has a signed 'inter-institutional' agreement.

metadata.chunk_title: Staff Mobility for Teaching

programme_facts.value: Check with UL Global prior to submitting your application to ensure the institution to which you are considering travelling holds a valid mobility agreement with UL.

metadata.chunk_title: Staff Mobility for Teaching

programme_facts.value: A funded duration for staff mobility must be a minimum of 2 days (excluding travel) and a maximum of 7 days (including travel).

metadata.chunk_title: Staff Mobility for Teaching

programme_facts.value: UL faculty attending a partner institution as part of Erasmus+ Staff Mobility for Teaching must fulfil a minimum of 8 teaching hours per week during their mobility.
